text:
June: quick UX review of the Compliance panel  saw a few micro nits around KMS labels, timeline entries, and narrow layouts. can we triage?
Ravi: yep, list them out please.
June: 1) KMS label currently displays the full ARN inline -> causes wrap and noise. 2) audit timeline rows dump the full ARN + raw timestamp, hard to scan. 3) on small widths the region picker is separated from the encryption toggle so the toggle gets pushed below the CTA.
Nora: for the label, suggest: primary line -> `Customer key (CMK)`; secondary muted line -> `key-9f3a` only shown in expanded details. keeps scanning clean.
Ravi: +1. shorter headline improves voiceover readouts too.
June: timeline copy example now: `2026-05-04 11:22:03 - key applied: arn:... user=bob`  propose `11:22 UTC  Key used by bob (key-9f3a)` with a chevron to view full details (ARN, request id). use past tense verbs.
Nora: accessibility nit: the encrypt toggle's aria-label reads the full ARN. change to aria-describedby pointing to the short headline; full ARN only in the details panel.
Ravi: layout: on narrow screens stack: Region > Retention > Encryption toggle so the toggle remains visible.
June: retention CTA copy: swap `Set retention` -> `Change retention period` for clarity.
Nora: add a hover tooltip on the key label: `View key details` and a small copy icon for the truncated id.
Ravi: I'll update the Figma and open a tiny copy PR. tagging @a11y for a quick review on aria pattern.
June: thanks! can someone file a tracking issue?
ux-bot: note created - ISSUE-4572 "Compact KMS label + timeline readability" (priority P3).
Ravi: filing PR and INF ticket now, will tag design + a11y for review.
June: perfect, thanks team :raised_hands:
